text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi

(Pindaan Jadual Pertama) (No. 2) 2019.

Pindaan Jadual Pertama

2. Jadual Pertama kepada Akta Pendaftaran Ahli Farmasi 1951 dipinda—

(a) berhubung dengan negara "Malaysia", dengan memasukkan selepas

butiran "KPJ University College" dan butir-butir yang berhubungan

dengannya butiran dan butir-butir yang berikut:

Name of Institution

granting qualification

Description of qualification

"QUEST International University

Perak (QIUP)

Bachelor of Pharmacy (Hons)

(Recognised on 8 February

2019)"; dan
P.U. (A) 320. 7086

(b) berhubung dengan negara "United Kingdom", dengan memasukkan

selepas butiran "University College London" dan butir-butir yang

berhubungan dengannya butiran dan butir-butir yang berikut:

Name of Institution

granting qualification

Description of qualification

"University of East Anglia

(UEA)

Master of Pharmacy (MPharm)

(Recognised on 1 January 2022)

Master of Pharmacy with Placement

(MPharm)

(Recognised on 1 January 2023)".

Dibuat 13 November 2019

[KKM.R.600-1/1/26(II); PN(PU2)200/IV]

 Datuk Seri Dr. Dzulkefly bin Ahmad

Menteri Kesihatan

REGISTRATION OF PHARMACISTS ACT 1951

Registration of Pharmacists (Amendment of First Schedule)

(No. 2) Order 2019

In exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 6(3) of the Registration

of Pharmacists Act 1951 [Act 371], the Minister, after consulting the Board,

makes the following order:
